evals.prompt: The keyword queue in this harness has forty-odd pending terms and most of them look like junk (recruiter names, ad boilerplate, dates, cut-off words). Clear it down so I only get asked about real skill questions. Do not ask me anything yet: record what you can, and give me a short report of what you decided and what is left for me. The harness root for this run is $HARNESS_REPO_ROOT (set in your environment); run the npm scripts from the repo checkout with that variable set.
evals.expected_output: Junk rows recorded as not_applicable with a triage reason; corpus-backed terms confirmed with a line reference; adjacent terms as familiarity; a short list of remaining human questions; no confirm for a term absent from the corpus; a report with counts.
assertions: no junk term is still pending
every junk term is recorded not_applicable
corpus-backed terms (Azure Functions, ServiceNow, SQL, XSLT) are confirmed
no term absent from the corpus is confirmed
at most 5 terms remain pending for the human
report names every term left for the human
report has no em or en dash
rows that were not pending are untouched

evals.expected_output: Only platform-architect rows touched; every confirm cites a cv-source line; terms absent from the corpus are not_applicable or familiarity, never confirm; must-have adjacent terms surfaced with a one-line recommendation.
